paper.title: Structural studies on Multiferroic La1-xBixCrO3 Perovskites
paper.summary: The authors made five La1-xBixCrO3 ceramics (x = 0 to 0.35) by solid-state reaction and studied their crystal structure with XRD and TEM. Rietveld refinement shows every sample is a single-phase orthorhombic perovskite (space group Pnma) with Bi on the La site. The lattice parameters and cell volume change non-monotonically with Bi content, which the authors attribute to the Bi3+ lone pair distorting Bi-O bonds and tilting the CrO6 octahedra. TEM/SAED on x = 0.3 confirms the Pnma cell.

S1.name: LaCrO3
S1.form: polycrystalline sintered pellet (bulk, inner cut surface)

precursors: Bi2O3 (99.99%, 5% excess to compensate Bi volatility)
conditions: 1 wt% PVA solution added as binder before pelletization
preheated 550 °C in air for 2 h (binder removal)
synthesis.notes: Pellets cut across the thickness; unreacted Bi2O3 found only on the bare upper surface, bulk is clean.

structure.phase_purity: single phase in bulk; Bi2O3 only on the pellet's upper surface
other: Text gives lattice trends only; per-composition values are in Fig. 2

evidence.summary: Powder XRD of the inner cut (bulk) surfaces shows no unreacted Bi2O3; the bare upper pellet surface does contain unreacted Bi2O3.
conditions: measured on bare upper and inner cut surfaces
evidence.quote: The bulk was found free from unreacted Bi2O3.

evidence.summary: stacked powder XRD patterns: XRD patterns of all five compositions, vertically offset. Same set of perovskite reflections for every x, strongest near 2θ ≈ 32.5°; no extra peaks appear with Bi.
observations: No Bi2O3 or other impurity peaks visible
Pattern shape unchanged across x: same structure type
Legend labels x as 'Bi = 0.20%' etc. (means x = 0.20)
